verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a business and lien registry portal could plausibly offer bulk filing or batch processing, but nothing in the evidence shows it. 'Multiple filings on multiple entities can be processed thru one Online Account' describes one account handling many separate filings, not a single operation across many items at once. 'Data and Image Subscriptions' is a bare title for a data feed, not bulk actions on items. Neither is credited.
